name: @aphrody/material-symbols-source
description: Material Symbols sources of the aphrody branch: variable fonts (web WOFF2, desktop TTF), optimized 24 px SVGs and their manifest, regenerated with Bun.

scripts.build: bun scripts/fonts.ts && bun scripts/optimize-svg.ts && bun scripts/manifest.ts
scripts.check: bun scripts/optimize-svg.ts --check && bun scripts/manifest.ts --check && bun scripts/fonts.ts --check
